zh.forceHeader: 三档效力：标记长什么样，违反了怎么办
zh.forceNote: 一篇文档可以同时含三档；未标注效力的句子不构成条文
zh.mfBody: 不满足即判为缺陷，审核可拒 → 必须修改或给出书面例外理由。
zh.mfExample: Button 计算高度只允许 36 或 28。
zh.rcBody: 默认照做；偏离需在插件 README 说明理由 → 不阻塞合并，但记录在案。
zh.rcExample: TK-RC-13 不得引入档位外的字号。
zh.adBody: 供取舍参考，允许按场景判断 → 无需说明。
zh.numberingHeader: 编号：域 + 效力 + 序号
zh.numberingNote: 引用方式：「依据 DSH Design Resources `FL-MF-03`」；70-checklist.md 只引用编号，数值以正文为准
zh.ruleFlMf03: FL 骨架 · 强制 · 第 3 条
zh.ruleSlRc04: SL 座位 · 推荐 · 第 4 条
zh.ruleSlAd07: SL 座位 · 建议 · 第 7 条
zh.domainCodes: FL 骨架 · SL 座位 · CT 控件 · TK 令牌 · MO 动效 · IC 图标 · AC 可访问性 · CF 冲突
zh.sourcesHeader: 五个来源标签：没有标签的数值就算缺陷
zh.sourcesNote: 铁律：某维度确实没有权威数值时，必须写成「无权威数值，本仓库建议 X，理由 Y」——不得沉默，也不得伪造出处
zh.sourceHig: Apple Human Interface Guidelines 官方条文
zh.sourceDshCss: DSH 官方未压缩 CSS 源（部分注释注明来自 Figma 组件实例）
zh.sourceMeasured: 在本仓库对本机 DSH 资产／声明做全量统计得出，方法可复现
zh.sourceProposed: 无权威数值，本仓库给出的建议值与理由
zh.officialFirstNote: 本规范约束的是新写的界面与插件之间的协调，不是推翻产品自身的既有实现；为了对齐规范去覆盖官方控件，恰恰违反 CT-MF-12
zh.conflictTransitionText: 沿用官方值 · Switch 滑块是官方 120ms ease，不在五档之内
zh.conflictStatesLabel: 官方控件未提供的状态
zh.conflictStatesText: 不自行补样式 · Switch 没有 hover 态、Pill 没有 active 态
zh.conflictGapText: 不套用控件间距建议 · Button 文本与图标之间是官方 gap 4px

en.forceHeader: Three levels of force: what the marker looks like, and what breaking it triggers
en.forceNote: One document can carry all three levels at once; a sentence with no level marked is not a clause
en.mfBody: Anything short of this is a defect and review may reject it → you either change it or give a written reason for the exception.
en.mfExample: Button heights are only ever 36 or 28.
en.rcBody: Follow it by default; a deviation needs its reason in the plugin README → it does not block the merge, but it goes on the record.
en.rcExample: TK-RC-13 Do not introduce sizes off the scale.
en.adBody: A reference point for judgement calls that may go either way → no explanation needed.
en.numberingNote: Quoting works as “according to DSH Design Resources `FL-MF-03`”; 70-checklist.md carries only the number, and the value in the document text is the one that holds
en.domainCodes: FL frame · SL seats · CT controls · TK tokens · MO motion · IC icons · AC accessibility · CF conflicts
en.sourcesHeader: Five source labels: a value with no label is a defect
en.sourcesNote: The iron rule: when a dimension genuinely has no authoritative value, write “no authoritative value, proposed here X, reason Y” — staying silent and inventing a source are both ruled out
en.sourceHig: A published clause of the Apple Human Interface Guidelines
en.sourceOh: The full text of the official OpenHarmony documentation
en.sourceDshCss: The official unminified DSH CSS source (some comments note that they come from Figma component instances)
en.sourceMeasured: Counted in full over this machine's DSH assets and declarations, with a method anyone can repeat
en.sourceProposed: No authoritative value exists; this is the value proposed here plus its reason
en.officialFirstHeader: When they conflict, the official implementation wins
en.officialFirstNote: This spec governs new interfaces and how plugins get along with each other; it does not overturn the product's own implementations. Overriding an official control to line it up with the spec is itself a breach of CT-MF-12
en.conflictTransitionLabel: A transition the official control brings with it
en.conflictTransitionText: Keep the official value · the Switch thumb is the official 120ms ease, which is not one of the five gears
en.conflictStatesLabel: A state the official control does not provide
en.conflictStatesText: Do not style it in yourself · Switch has no hover state and Pill has no active state
en.conflictGapText: Do not apply the between-controls spacing recommendation · Button uses the official gap 4px between its text and its icon
